title: Journalling
content:
Adding Notes to Trade Days
To add a note to your trade day, follow these steps:
Navigate to your Performance Stats page on the trading platform.
Scroll down to the Calendar
Click on a Calendar Day
Click the Add Journal button
Write a journal entry
Click Save Journal
A Note icon will appear on the calendar day if a Trading Day note or an Individual Trade note exists on that day.
Adding Notes to Individual Trades
To add notes to individual trades, you may do so through the Calendar or the Trades Panel within your Performance Stats page.
Navigate to your Performance Stats page on the trading platform.
Access the Trades panel by either:
Clicking on a Calendar Day or
Scrolling down to the Trades panel
Click the Add Journal icon
Write a journal entry
Click Save Journal

Adding Notes to Trade Days

To add a note to your trade day, follow these steps:

  1. Navigate to your Performance Stats page on the trading platform.

  2. Scroll down to the Calendar

  3. Click on a Calendar Day

  4. Click the Add Journal button

  5. Write a journal entry

  6. Click Save Journal

A Note icon will appear on the calendar day if a Trading Day note or an Individual Trade note exists on that day.

Adding Notes to Individual Trades

To add notes to individual trades, you may do so through the Calendar or the Trades Panel within your Performance Stats page.

  1. Navigate to your Performance Stats page on the trading platform.

  2. Access the Trades panel by either:

    1. Clicking on a Calendar Day or

    2. Scrolling down to the Trades panel

  3. Click the Add Journal icon

  4. Write a journal entry

  5. Click Save Journal
